content: Satan no Yesus wala-wala tuwai.
Saini waha langa, Satan no Yesus wala-wala tuwei nomo bona, Hauri Guuni no Yesus haudu ha fai uwau langa manai.
Onodu Yesus no da nyei uwa hoonga 40 ooru 40 yafai, iinga no huweli tuwai.
Ono gainga, wala-wala nigigou fai no bagu maidu letuwai, “Ne ngalenga Itou Idau wonga, ne lewahenga megebu beha edo ubuludu beret heigode.”

Ono wainga Yesus no beele benou gidu letuwai, Itou nomo buk langa beele benou bagu, nere fai-aita bagu da langanga agenege auma yafou ada tetede. Uwa. Nere Itou nomo beele oruwanga fere edo oojodu agenege auma yafou todbode.
No onou lewainga, Satan no haudu Jerusalem goyai Itou nomo taon langa, onodu no gai ouwe la tafa tuwai.

Onodu Satan no onou letuwai, Ne ngalenga Itou Idau wonga, ne talagedu minau. Taate bona, Itou nomo buk langa beele benou bagu, no nomo ensel lenigonga nere ne edola oofa hinodbode, onodu nere owonege langa ne aule hinodbode, gamaji megebu ete afene waroga.
Ono wainga, Yesus letuwai, “Itou nomo buk ege onou lena, ‘Ne name Anyakaro Itou nomo danga adai wala-wala fuwau.’ ”
Ono wainga Satan no ege Yesus haudu garou ete gai ouwe langa manai. Onodu Satan no oula beha nomo kantri, danga oruwa bagu nebere dada hilou-hilou bagu abitimu tuwai.
Onodu bona no Yesus benou letuwai, “Ne afene tuburu kutudu ji hauya hibonahe wonga wa, ji dada waha oruwa ne hinonboni.”
Ono wainga Yesus no letuwai, “Satan ne sinawau. Itou nomo buk lena, ‘ne Itou nomo huuna la yafau, name anyakaro, onodu no nogonga unyi isouwau.’”
Ono wainga Satan no awa tuwai. Ono gainga nere ensel medu bode Yesus hoyo tuwane.
Yesus no Galili langa haruwe hugu warai.
Saini Yesus no Jon dagou mata langa tafa tuwane waha beele isidu bona, no Galili distrik langa goyai.
Onodu bona no Nasaret taon awadu goi Kaperneam taon langa yafai. Kaperneam no Galili yaage katiwou hinemu langa inyina, Sebulun Naptali bagu nebere oula la.
Onodu fanyimu waha langa, Itou nomo beele ete profet Aisaia hurau langa benou lewai waha Yesus no edomuwai.

“Nere Sebulun oulaha fai-aita bagu, nere Naptali oulaha fai-aita bagu nebere oula wa, jala anyakaro hiiri langa minou jugu la inyina. Onodu oula Jordan yaage ulate la inyina wa Galili distrik nebere. Distrik waha, fai-aita bagu kantri fere-fereha baingaro yafade,
nere fai-aita bagu agugu langa yafade waha nere lala anyakaro amina urane. Nere fai-aita bagu agugu bagu langa yafade waha lala nere langa amina heigaiha.”
Yesus no fai aise, yaure nigainga oojo tuwane.
Saini waha langa Yesus no beele lenigou hugu warai. No lewai, “Tere huwanyatege ubulu wagu, taate bona, ha laluwa nomo huuna la yafei nomo amina jugu waha.”

Yesus no Galili yaage katiwou mou langa golo bona, no fai nga nononga bemu ngare nerirai. No Saimon, nomo unyi ete nere lede, Pita, no nomo bemu Andru. Nere nga hagoma yaage katiwou langa ayawou haruwe tare. Nere moni kusewei nomo hoowe haruwe tetedere.
Ariya Yesus no nere nga benou lenirai, tere taga hidu mayaru. “Ji tere fai-aita bagu elege nigei nomo fanyimu waha abitimu tironboni.”
Ono wainga, nere fasayadu onou neire hagoma awaare inyi gainga no oojo tuware.

Yesus no ege menanga onou golodu goibona, no ege, fai nga nononga bemu ngare nerirai. Jems, no Sebedi idau, nomo bemu Jon ngare nerirai. Nere bot langa amenere Sebedi ngate yafane. Nere nebere hagoma korai wainga erere bode yafa ganenga, no yaure nirai.
Ono wainga nere fasayadu onou, amenere bot langa awa tudu Yesus oojo tuware.
Yesus no beele malalamudu lebona fai-aita bagu baingaro taura jigemu nagai.

Yesus goidu Galili distrik ulate langa oruwa golowai. Ono bona no fai-aita bagu nebere bori mata huwanya langa goidu isisiwou nigigai. No Itou nomo huuna langa yafei nomo hilou beele malalamudu lenigi bona, fai-aita genege gala taura bagu, dada inyaba oruwa nere genege gala inyabamu nagai waha jigemu nagai.

Ono wainga nere Siria prowins oruwa nebere aasa hai fuwane. Waha bode nere fai oruwa taura hugu fere-fere bagu, jimiri inyaba tetede waha bagu, nere fai hauri inyaba bagu, nere fai kusibu narige ganga mebodudu tererede waha bagu, nere fai ngedonege ume borowou waha bagu hanigedu mayane. Ono wanenga no ege jigemu nigai.
Ono wainga nere fai-aita bagu baingaro, Galili bagu, ulate Dekapolis distrikha bagu, Jerusalem bagu, Judia bagu, oula Jordan yaage ulate la inyina bagu, nere no oojo tugane.
